proposal.description: The cycle-boundary pulse is registered instead of combinational, so the qualifying counter advances one clock after the PWM falling edge is seen rather than on it
proposal.reason: With the rail good in S_RUN, the counter reaches TARGET, and PGOOD rises, one clock later than it should after the qualifying PWM falling edge. A comparator dip or S_RUN exit on the clock right after a falling edge now wins over that late boundary pulse.
